Observer enabled usesGantt || agentRunningFilter; dependency active only agentRunningFilter. type=issue; my scope maps all to any, otherwise scope.relation; other scopes omit mine relation; parent omitted. Observer and dependency enabled/active agentIdleFilter; raw snapshot query, same stale/gc/focus options as running.

usesMyAgents means simple or advanced relation my_agents; observer enabled usesMyAgents. workspace_id=wsId if truthy, include_archived=true. refetchInterval 30000 only if data has nonarchived online/unstable agent; otherwise false.
Same usesMyAgents source gate. Controller enabled overrides factory enabled !!wsId after spreading options. Client 5209-5216 parses squad_ids and throws on malformed body.
usesSubscribed means simple or advanced subscribed relation; observer enabled usesSubscribed. Client 3177-3184 parses issue_ids and throws on malformed body.

retry_contract: Inactive or defined-data sources resolve, including stale data with error. False entries ignored. Undefined failed sources captured; retry invokes only these without awaiting, catching or deduplication. combine captures error states only. Controller 1082-1088 orders status (catalog+projects), working (running+idle), unread, relation; find exposes only first failing category at 1115-1117. Relation retry uses injected sources only when client predicates active. Enabled flags govern automatic query execution, not a blanket prohibition on manual refetch.
gating: controller 599 membershipUnresolved joins working/unread. Status branches 836 and group branches 882 require !statusFilterUnresolved && !membershipUnresolved. Data project/relation pending contribute loading, errors suppress empty (data final return). Controller empty also requires !membershipUnresolved. No claim every controller fetch is gated by every dependency.
limitations: Possible transport union, not runtime count, successful backend behavior or global coverage.
